# growthbook_environment (Data Source)

Reads a single GrowthBook environment by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "growthbook_environment" "production" {
  id = "production"
}

output "production_toggle_on_list" {
  value = data.growthbook_environment.production.toggle_on_list
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Environment id, for example `production`.

### Read-Only

- `default_state` (Boolean) Default enabled state for new features in this environment.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the environment.
- `parent` (String) Id of the parent environment, if any.
- `projects` (Set of String) Project ids this environment is scoped to.
- `toggle_on_list` (Boolean) Whether this environment appears in the feature list toggle.
